price_unit: historical API-equivalent USD per million, excluding unmeasured cache write surcharge. Native ChatGPT subscription only
selection: Never lose an incumbent passing task. Otherwise accept a higher count of passing tasks, or the same count at 10% or greater total native token reduction.
pilot_budget: At most 103 fresh calls in one complete block, including 20 proposal calls, 60 candidate coding runs, 3 common initial optimization runs and 20 final and baseline held-out runs. Five rounds per arm. No retries.
primary: Held-out pass proportion for the frozen final harness, one independent call per assigned task
